item.title: The Victory Cigar: What's it like to be a cigar shop during Alabama-Tennessee rivalry week?
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
For football fans in Alabama and Tennessee, the Third Saturday in October means participating in one of the greatest traditions in college football…but only if you win! Gary Conger from Cigars & More 280 in Birmingham explains the tradition of the victory cigar, how it became a part of the Alabama-Tennessee rivalry, and why it’s so special for fans.

item.title: Auburn's 2005 win over Georgia in Athens featured a wild 4th down play in the final minutes
item.author: Auburn Tigers on AL.com
item.description: Auburn defeated Georgia 31-30 in 2005 off the foot of field goal kicker John Vaughn. The winning kick came after Brandon Cox's 63-yard pass to Devin Aromashodu on 4th and 10 with less than two minutes to play.

item.title: Did Alabama get HOSED vs. Georgia? 😡 The Tide better REBOUND at Tennessee!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Alabama lost a heavyweight fight to Georgia. The pass interference no-call upset Kalen DeBoer and fans, but the Crimson Tide have to move on, because the SEC gauntlet continues in Knoxville this week. Cruz Oxenreider joins Ben Flanagan to revisit some key Georgia game storylines like DeBoer's coaching of Dijon Lee Jr. and what Bama needs to fix before facing Tennessee in the Third Saturday in October. Then Cruz plays our new game about all that happened in the world during Alabama's 15-game win streak against the Vols during the Nick Saban era. Plus, former Alabama football star Tyler Booker shares his favorite Alabama teammate, toughest guy to block in the NFL, and the SEC team he hates most.
